en: The postcard features a black-and-white, hand-colored image of a large stone building with a clock tower and battlements, flying an American flag. The building is situated on a grassy hill. The text identifies the building as the 'Store-house at U.S. Arsenal' located in Benicia, California. There is printed information along the left and right sides, indicating it was printed and hand-colored in Germany and published by Frank J. Stumm, Benicia, Cal.
